text: The NEAR Open PASSPORT entry: an agent reputation passport with escrow history. Thirty three checks, fifteen claims traced, a real contract on the testnet.

The evidence first: two published artifacts, every record re-hashed. Fifteen claims traced, zero refused. Then agent ava. Settlement, disclosure and privacy pass, but community scores twenty eight point four three against a bar of fifty, so the gates say refused. The composite is seventy seven point five two, and it is not what the gate reads.

Now the escrow. Bob's is opened, funded and released. Ava's is funded and the release is refused: community scores twenty eight point four two five five, needs fifty. The note says it outright. Ava's composite was seventy seven point five two, and it is not consulted.
That opening escrow for agent bob, on the public testnet explorer. It is on chain, it succeeded, and it is one of the cited hashes.

The deployed contract, read back from the chain. Agent ava: composite seventy seven point five two, community twenty eight point four two five five. Agent bob: composite eighty five point one three, community eighty five point two seven.
And the escrow history read, the case the gate refuses. Agent ava's escrow history is empty, because the contract refused it. And the threshold the gates read: fifty.
The verification script the house can re-run. Thirty three checks, all passed, exit code zero.
And provenance on its own. Fifteen claims, fifteen traceable.
Agent ava's registration, on the public testnet explorer.
And the refusal. This transaction failed on chain: refused, community score below the threshold.
Every step is reproducible from the published tree: clone it, run the verification script, read the contract back with near view.
